segments.name: Advertising Platform
segments.description: Omnichannel advertising platform connecting advertisers and media owners to drive advertising outcomes across digital channels.
segments.evidence: The Company is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers purchase media owner inventory through the platform via cost per click, cost per thousand impressions, or guaranteed minimum arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from advertisers purchasing media owner inventory through our platform.

changes.text: In 2025, Outbrain completed acquisition of Legacy Teads in February and changed its corporate name to Teads Holding Co. in June.
changes.evidence: On February 3, 2025, Outbrain Inc. ("Outbrain") completed its acquisition (the "Acquisition") of TEADS, a private limited liability company ( société à responsabilité limitée ) incorporated and existing under the laws of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg ("Legacy Teads").
